issue_title: Sorcerer Supreme of the Galaxy Part One
description:
NEW SPELLS, ALLIES & ENEMIES IN THIS NEW SERIES FROM MARK WAID & JESUS SAIZ!

SORCERER SUPREME...OF THE GALAXY!

The Eye of Agamotto is closed! Doctor Stephen Strange has lost his connection to the Earth's arcane power, and he can't wait to recover while nightmares press against the seams of our reality. Tony Stark offers a 21st-century solution: When astral travel fails, try astronautical travel. Enter Doctor Strange: Space-Explorer Supreme! New spells, allies and enemies - new and old - await Strange beyond the stars, along with corners and secrets of the Marvel Universe seen here for the first time! Space is endless, but time is short. After years of threats, Stephen's bill for magic use is coming due - who will come to collect?!

issue_title: Bully For You Part 1; Pokey Piquenose; Bonk Choy Bro-down
description:
Based on the hit video game franchise!

Dr. Zomboss’s crime-filled college years are revealed! Nate, Patrice, and Crazy Dave find Neighborville besieged by two zombie armies. Paul Tobin and Ron Chan join forces with the mysterious Anti-Bully Squad to deliver a hilarious romp to your school! Featuring two bonus stories illustrated by Dustin Nguyen (Batman: Li’l Gotham, Descender)!

Bonus stories by all-star guest artist Dustin Nguyen!

The hit video game franchise continues its comic book invasion!

In this issue, Zomboss once again plans to conquer Neighborville. A plan involving spiders makes him recall his college days, and the many people he pranked at that time. Several people he comes into contact with make a phone call to a mysterious figure who plans to give Zomboss his comeuppance.

Meanwhile Crazy Dave, Nate, and Patrice monitor their neighborhood, using Magnifying Grass among others. They see that Zomboss is on his way, so Patrice and Nate try to trick Dave into coming by saying they're going out for ice cream.

When they find Zomboss, Dave thinks they are actually going for ice cream, and leaves the kids in search of some tasty treats. Then the Anti-Bullying Squad, a group of zombies Zomboss harassed in college, shows up.

Features back-up stories about Pokey Piquenose, whose thesis Zomboss stole, and a Bonk Choy's day of training.

description: Lawrence, the mystical Boom Boom Mushroom, appears at last! Will Crazy Dave and the kids convince him to help save Neighborville? This issue includes bonus stories by PopCap Games senior creative director Jeremy Vanhoozer!

issue_title: Bully For You Part 2; Blown Away; The Sunfrowner
description:
Based on the hit video game franchise!

Dr. Zomboss’s college-era crimes catch up with him—and karma comes in the form of the strange Anti-Bully Squad! Nate, Patrice, Crazy Dave, and a batch of overwhelmed plants are caught in between two zombie hordes! Featuring two bonus stories illustrated by guest artist Jennifer L. Meyer (Jim Henson’s The Storyteller, Star Wars Adventures)!

Over 500,000 in print!

The hit video game franchise continues its all-ages comic book invasion!

In this issue, Patrice and Nate battle the Anti-Bullying Squad's college student zombies, while the Squad taunts the now-locked-up Zomboss, who bullied them in college.

Meanwhile, Crazy Dave attempts to eat a huge amount of ice cream before it melts, while onlookers watch in suspense.

The Anti-Bullying Squad, including Stilts the Imp, Greg-Gantuar the Gargantuar (with his pet Mr. Stubbins), and Mr. Grim-Brim, tells their stories of harassment by Zomboss. They tell him that they took away everything he holds dear, including his toenail clippings collection, zombie soap opera DVDs, and goldfish bowl. Now they will take over Neighborville before he does, by persuading his zombies to work for them, and adding it to their college zombies.

Crazy Dave unfortunately loses his battle with the ice cream, to the sadness of all. Patrice and Nate try to persuade him to help against the new zombie army, but he decides to make non-melting ice cream instead.

Also features back-up stories about Balloon Zombie daydreaming about being a hero, and an unusual grumpy Sunflower.

Dr. Zomboss’s battered zombie army faces the Anti-Bully Squad’s new zombie army! Patrice and Nate are caught in the middle, and the war spills into Neighborville. The town’s fearless young heroes must join forces with Crazy Dave to beat both batches of the fun-dead! Could an ice-cream break help?

Bonus PVZ stories by comics legend Peter Bagge!

The hit video game franchise continues its comic book invasion!

Crazy Dave creates unmeltable ice cream after his unfortunate accident the previous issue. Zomboss escapes the cell the Anti-Bully League put him in using a giant heat gun he hid under his coat, and gets right back to wreaking havoc. However, thanks to Mr. Stubbins, he is caught once more. This time they pat him down before putting him back in his cell.

The Anti-Bully League fights Patrice and Nate, but are losing. Zomboss takes over their army and attacks, but Dave protects them with a wall of his unmeltable ice cream, which Zomboss's heat gun is unable to melt!

The Anti-Bully League is forced to return to college with Zomboss as their gym teacher. And worse--Mr. Stubbins has defected to Zomboss's side!

Also features two short stories: an examination of Zomboss's love of Pop Smarts, and Mr. Stubbins's adventures throughout the galaxy.

issue_title: Grown Sweet Home Part 1; Chestbeard's Revenge
description:
A new story arc begins! A group of young plants move out of Crazy Dave’s garage and into his huge family mansion in Neighborville. But why is Dr. Zomboss spying on them? Artist Andie Tong joins writer Paul Tobin for this three-issue arc! Bonus stories by Karim Friha!

Chestbeard's Revenge: Chestbeard time travels to Neighborville to conquer it, but has his chest shaved by the Robot Orange Juice.

issue_title: Grown Sweet Home Part 2; A Day in the Life(ish) of a Zombie; The Zombie That Was Afraid of the Dark
description:
Nate and Patrice try to teach a batch of young plants how to be helpful and productive Neighborville citizens. What does Dr. Zomboss hope to find out by spying on them? Writer Paul Tobin and artist Andie Tong tell our main tale, and artist Nneka Myers draws this month’s bonus stories!

Over 500,000 copies in print.

A Day in the Life(ish) of a Zombie: a zombie stands around all day.

The Zombie That Was Afraid of the Dark: the origin of Disco Zombie.

issue_title: Grown Sweet Home Part 3; Know Your Zombie Holidays!; Tales of Zombie History, Episode 38: The Development of the Balloon Zombie
description:
The action-packed finale to the imp-filled Grown Sweet Home story arc! Armed with newfound knowledge of humanity, Dr. Zomboss launches a strike at the heart of Neighborville . . . and also sparks a series of all-star plant-versus-zombie brawls! Brian Churilla (Hellbreak, Creepy Comics) draws this month’s bonus stories!

Eisner Award winner Paul Tobin continues his hilarious PVZ run!

More than 500,000 PVZ collections sold!

Know Your Zombie Holidays: various wacky zombie holidays.

Tales of Zombie History, Episode 38: The Development of the Balloon Zombie: After failed attempts at creating kite zombies, beanie-propeller zombies, inflatable zombies, and others, Zomboss finally created Balloon Zombies.

Sun-powered, plant-driven speedsters vs. imp-powered, zombie-driven hot rods! Let the races begin! Crazy Dave takes on the incredibly tough Don’t Blink video game—and he also challenges Dr. Zomboss to a race to determine the future of Neighborville! Inventive Zomboss cars and souped-up zombie rigs are getting ready for another invasion!

Humans in hot rods, zombies in raucous roadsters, and plants perched in radical racers! The car-filled competition for Neighborville is underway, and Crazy Dave and Dr. Zomboss are neck and neck! Paul Tobin (Bandette, Colder) and Ron Chan (Star Wars, The Guild) return to deliver another hilarious zombie battle to your burg!

Dr. Zomboss unleashes a horde of mobile, fast-moving zombies on the innocent citizens of Neighborville! Riding inventive hot rods and crazy contraptions, both zombie and plant forces alike pull out all the creative stops in a series of contests to win control over the city! A competitive, race-filled finale as our Petal to the Metal story arc closes!

SERIES PREMIERE

CRIMINAL colorist and first time solo artist JACOB PHILLIPS and writer CHRIS CONDON break onto the scene with a brand-new ongoing series! Like Paris, Texas gut-punched by No Country for Old Men, this mature neo-Western crime series kicks off when the search for a casserole dish leads to a dark and tense confrontation on Sheriff Joe Bob Coates’ 70th birthday.

“CHRIS & JACOB pull off something remarkable here. A vivid and bright story that nails a thorough sense of foreboding and darkness. A shocking amount of talent for a duo so fresh to comics!” —CHIP ZDARSKY (SEX CRIMINALS, Daredevil)

In the past, the Lord of the Apes has risked his life to save many people -- some of whom he called friend and others for whom he had no name. Now, it is Jane who needs saving. She is dying, the result of a mysterious virus. And with no one to battle, no savage creatures to fend off, for the first time in his life, Tarzan feels helpless.

A fantastic, hypnotic emerald has given Private Mann control over the rest of his Nazi infantry and the warrior women of Zuli. And, yet, this newfound power is pointless to him unless he can get back to civilization. Tarzan won't let him do that, and Tarzan cannot be controlled by the emerald. But there are other things which Mann can use to control the Lord of the Apes...

Beasts, savages, natural disasters -- these are the threats of the jungle, the things Tarzan has learned to control. But there is nothing natural about his current quarry. In turn-of-the-century Paris, the Lord of the Jungle faces a masked, tuxedo-clad assailant who carries off women; a beast with the trappings of "civilization." A phantom of the opera.
In the sewers of Paris and out of his element, Tarzan, Lord of the Jungle, faces the "civilized" monster of the concrete jungle: The Phantom of the Opera!

Tarzan encounters the concrete jungle! New York's scientific community is fighting over rights to the notebooks of Dr. Victor von Frankenstein, and the jungle lord finds himself pulled into the middle of the fray when a hulking monster figures into the mix. This issue features Thomas Edison, Nikola Tesla, Arthur Conan Doyle, and Frankenstein's monster!

The notes of Dr. Victor von Frankenstein, the greatest scientific mind of the nineteenth century, have fallen into the hands of the greatest scientific mind of the twentieth century, Thomas Edison. Tarzan is determined that Edison will not repeat the mistakes of the late Dr. Frankenstein . . . but there's a hulking beast that has his own stake in all of this!

When the NYPD needs help tracking a brutal serial murderer, they call on Tarzan. But even he's confused when he finds two scents where there should be one! The killer is two different people in a single body, and that spells double trouble for the Lord of the Jungle!

A madman with the strength of a bull ape stalks the cobblestoned alleys of Manhattan, his brain a peculiar dialogue between the power of the intellect and the nature of the beast. Tarzan must stop him before he can kill again, but not before he reflects upon his own similarity to the man/monster that is Jekyll and Hyde!

issue_title: Tarzan vs. The Moon Men (Part 1 of 4)
description: A stranger with a familiar face has come to Tarzan's African estate to seek help from the jungle lord: alien hordes from the moon have all but conquered the Earth of the far future, and only the Waziri remain! Tarzan and his son, Korak must accompany the stranger into the cave of Nu, and lead a battle in the 24th Century!

issue_title: Tarzan vs. The Moon Men (Part 2 of 4)
description: Somewhere in the ravaged jungles of 24th Century Africa, Tarzan and his son Korak must face invading hordes of Vagas from the Earth's moon. But even as the jungle lord's piercing cry strikes fear into the hearts of the Vagas, it is drowned out by the roar of rockets bringing fresh troops to Earth!

issue_title: Tarzan vs. The Moon Men (Part 3 of 4)
description: A daring infiltration into the enemy's camp turns sour as Tarzan is captured, but Korak himself catches the daughter of Jemadar Ortiz, and she may provide the key . . . both to Tarzan's rescue, and to the defeat of the lunar invaders!

Jane will die of a bizarre virus if Tarzan cannot find the white dahlia, a rare flower thought to counteract the disease. Between the Lord of the Apes and this herbal cure stand enormous, mutated spiders and deadly, six-legged lions! And as brutal as both may be, they will fall before the might of "Tarzan's Jungle Fury"!

issue_title: Tarzan vs. The Moon Men (Part 4 of 4)
description: As the lunar hordes arrive to sweep across Africa and claim the Earth for their own, Tarzan calls upon his trickster side in the hope of scaring the Vagas back into space with an ancient enemy! But the chief of the Moon Men has a powerful hunger . . . a hunger that can only be sated with a bellyful of steel, or the blood of a jungle lord!

Tarzan has many friends among the creatures of the jungle, but few are as close to him as the mighty lion Jad-bal-ja. He is an honorable beast, and would protect Tarzan at any cost. But infected with the Tara virus, he is Tarzan's most fearsome enemy!

The Tara virus has killed many men and many beasts, and now it threatens Tarzan's most beloved friend, Jane. It may be Tarzan's most fearsome foe yet -- a foe he cannot battle -- and that it was brought to earth by the Lord of the Jungle himself only makes Tarzan's fury that much greater.

Tarzan has the cure to the Tara virus -- the genetic virus that is quickly killing his beloved Jane. But the cure is in his own blood, and there are plenty of monstrosities and evil men who wish to spill that blood before Tarzan can ever get back to his mate!

Jane is dying from the mysterious Tara virus. Only Tarzan, her mate, can save her -- he holds the cure in his blood. But there is plenty between Tarzan and home -- namely, monstrosities and the evil Ahrtan, who want to spill Tarzan's blood instead! The final, show-stopping conclusion of Tarzan's conflict with the Ahrtan -- and himself!

Tarzan's battle with the evil Ahrtan is over, but the real danger has just begun! Tarzan and Mugambi are traveling through upper Kenya when they discover that an artifact of immense power has fallen into the hands of a Nazi private. It could make this lowly soldier the ruler of the world -- if he could only get out of the jungle! Thus begins "Tarzan and the Legion of Hate," the second story arc in the ongoing Tarzan series. This is a great place for new readers to swing into the action!

The Emerald of the Zuli is an immense gem with mind-controlling powers -- with that gem, a Nazi refugee controls his entire squad and the warrior women of Zuli, who, in their quest for purity, have unwittingly embraced the foul Nazi ideology. Deep within the jungles of upper Kenya, Tarzan must battle the magnificent female warriors as well as the squad of Nazis -- and all the odds are against him!

Renegade Nazis! Warrior jungle women! And a mind-controlling emerald! It all adds up to one thing: big trouble in upper Kenya! If Tarzan cannot defuse this situation now, deep within the jungles of Africa, the battle could be taken back to civilization, where millions of innocents could be subjected to the emerald's hypnotic power -- and that's a battle he cannot afford to face.

The team seems to have their heart's desires. Grunge and Roxy have time to themselves. Caitlin leads a team of adoring heroes. But in such a paradise why is Rainmaker miserable? And other things are slowly going wrong.

The movie concludes with Grunge as the star battling T.H.E. B.I.G. B.O.S.S. who turns out to be Lynch. Grunge narrates his epically heroic and awesome drunk stylized finishing fight moves well after Lynch overtakes Farichild and Freefall with toy race car tracks (?). The goofball gags run amuck like Grunge's imagination, but heck you can only predict the silliness that ends after the credits roll.

issue_title: The Castle Of Doctor Monstro! Part 1
The Castle Of Doctor Monstro! Part 2
description: Most of the team have been changed into animal hybrids and it's up to Fairchild to rescue them.
Grunge storms out of the house to be alone and clear his head. An accident on his bike just gets things more muddled. Or does it?

Rowdy fistfights with villains on the beach would raise the ire of any neighbor. Fortunately the Gen13 crew makes friends, eventually, with their closest neighbors, saving them from danger. The kids end up filling a childless void in the couple's life.
Caitlin takes an elevator trip and becomes lost in time.

Grunge and Roxy watch a Hong Kong action film festival, inspiring Grunge to create his own action film.

Claiming that storylines are not critical in the current state of the film industry, Grunge makes up a plot for his film and describes it to Roxy, complete with product placement and mis-translations:

A Swordsman and his sidekick "Kiddo" (played by Grunge and Roxy) return to their village in historical China and find the villagers (played by Bobby and Sarah) massacred. They are attacked by the forces of the government (played by the DV8 team).

Grunge and Roxy are outnumbered and seemingly defeated by DV8, when they are rescued by a Shaolin warrior monk (played by Caitlin). With Caitlin's aid, Grunge and Roxy defeat DV8. Grunge discovers that the DV8 team is working for a villain known as "T.H.E.B.I.G.B.O.S!"

Roxy comments that Grunge's movie has, so far, been one scene of mindless violence.

Grunge responds by including unconnected love scenes inspired by "chick flicks" and by raunchier fare.

In Grunge's imaginary movie:

Grunge, Roxy, and Caitlin are attacked by agents of The Big Boss (played by the WildC.A.T.s, Wetworks, Deathblow and Stormwatch.) The three defeat their enemies in a series of gun battles referencing Quentin Tarantino films.

issue_title: I've Been In The Desert With An Orb With No Shame; A Comedy of Eros
description: To stop a brutal motorcycle gang, Hawkeye and the Orb launch a reign of unusual terror! Starfox takes a vow to rescue a fair damsel in distress and finds himself embarking on one of the wildest adventures of his life.

issue_title: Grimm and Bear It; Once There Was A Swordsman
description: Is this Hawkeye's last stand? It sure looks like it because not only is he up against the Brothers Grimm and Mad Dog - he's also gotta fight Bobcat and his gang of Claws! The Vision crashes the Tonight Show - and late night programming might not survive the experience!

Hawkeye finds himself up against Trickshot, Mad-Dog, Bobcat, Bombshell, the Brothers Grimm - in fact everyone he's fought ever since SOLO AVENGERS #1! The Vision crashes the Tonight Show and late-night television may never survive the experience! Guest-starring Johnny Carson, Ed McMahon, William Shatner, Pee-Wee Herman, and Charo.

issue_title: A Show of Hands; Waste Not Want Not
description: You'd think having Razorfist and his friends out to kill him would be enough trouble for Hawkeye. Now things are about to get worse - because someone's put a bounty on his arm! The astonishing origin of Firebird is revealed! It's an event that brings together almost every alien race in the Marvel Universe!
Hawkeye reaches the final showdown with the super villain who put a contract out on his arm - Crossfire! Plus: Rick Jones finds himself in the midst of an interstellar bidding war!

The ACTS OF VENGEANCE crossover saga begins here! One of the most powerful villains in the Marvel Universe has a long-standing grudge against the Avengers. This time he's come up with the ultimate plan to destroy them! Plus: Hawkeye and Iron Man embark on a desperate rescue mission to free guards trapped in The Vault!

Two ACTS OF VENGEANCE tales! It seems that nothing Hawkeye does can keep Crossfire down! Wait'll you see Crossfire's comeback! As Hawkeye discovers, it's sheer murder! Hawkeye takes on a suicide assignment - single-handedly stopping a mass escape of super-villains from the Vault!

Two ACTS OF VENGEANCE tales! Hawkeye and Mockingbird better get some ear-plugs because they're about to face the master and mistress of noise, Angar the Screamer and the mind-blasting Screaming Mimi! Plus: Iron Man vs. the Mad Thinker!
The ACTS OF VENGEANCE may be over, but try telling that to the Wizard and Klaw as they take on Iron Man!

A new direction! A new writer! A new costume for Hawkeye! A full-length, 22-page story kicks off a new start for the Avenging archer. And it starts with a brutal disaster when Hawkeye is almost killed by Hollywood street gangs!

issue_title: Hit and Run; Rocks and Hard Places
description: Hawkeye's one-man war against L.A. street gangs heats up! USAgent tries to discover who is brutally killing illegal aliens crossing the US/Mexican border - and suffers the consequences!

issue_title: Terminizer!; The Xenophobic Man, Part Two: Methods and Standards
description: Hawkeye's war on Hollywood gangs continues. Only now the police are after Hawkeye - and the charge is serial murder! USAgent is in a race against time to stop the Xenophobic Man from slaying more illegal aliens!

issue_title: Circle-T Killings Continue; Beliefs and Callings
description: Hawkeye's war against the Los Angeles street gangs continues! USAgents sets a trap for the Xenophobic Man - one that could turn the human bait into a corpse!

issue_title: Ashes; The Xenophobic Man, Part Four: The Ends and the Means
description: The Xenophobic Man returns and is ready to battle to the death! John Walker and Hawkeye might have met their match!
The legendary Gilgamesh is on the rise, recuperating from his battle wounds, and ready to take on the world of man!

This issue focuses on the return of Doctor Druid to the regular universe. Previously, Doctor Druid had been lost in a Time Bubble with Kang Nebula (Terminatrix). They realize that their idyllic life has been an illusion and escape back to earth. She traps the city the end up in within a time bubble before the age of marvels. She ejects him from the time bubble and he lands back at the monstary were he first learn his mystical powers. On this journey he learns that his mentor was actually the Ancient One, and he was meant to be a precursor to Dr. Strange...a John the Baptist almost. This gives Dr. Druid a renewed sense of purpose. He returns to the city and defeats Kang Nebula. In the resulting temporal battle he is de-aged.

Tigra, now shrunken to the size of a housecat, has forgotten her humanity. While fighting over scraps that an old woman is giving out, she is mauled by a pitbull terrier. She kills the dog and the old woman takes her to the vet to be put down. She is picked up from the vet by Agatha Harkness (Scarlet Witch's construct) who returns her to WCA headquarters. Agatha uses Hank's equipment to return Tigra to regular size and summons a cat person to help Tigra. Tubur knocks Agatha out and tries to Tigra. The seduction is prevented by Agatha and her cat. Tabur knocks Agatha out again and Tigra and Tabur fight until Agatha wakes up and shapeshifts Tabur into a regular housecat. Tigra regains the cat's amulet and returns to human form as Greer Nelson. She is able to change at will again.

While in Washington, DC, the Black Knight stops a robbery with the aid of his mighty sword, trusty steed and uncle's lance. He is then promptedly arrested because he fits the description of a sword-wielding maniac they are currently looking for. He is put in a line-up but after the witness cannot identify him and they find no blood on his sword he is released. At his castle, he meets with Mrs. Blackwood who is concerned that her husband has had a mental breakdown and is probably the man the police are looking for. Her husband is the masked vigilante named the Crusader. He attacks Washington, DC's airpot to kill the Emir of Ghulistan (whom he calls a saracen). Crusader fails in his attempt to assassinate the Emir because of Black Knight and his own daughter's interference.
The Vision's search for purpose takes a dangerous turn!

issue_title: The Dirty Devices of Dr. Dome!
description: Plastic Man nearly escapes from Dr. Dome. His daughter drugs him and puts him on a taffy puller.

issue_title: The Bogus-Men Will Get You if You Don't Watch Out!
If I Kill Me, Will I Die?

description: Note: This issue contains the Hostess Superhero Ad, Batman & Robin: Birds of a Feather.

issue_title: The Three Faces of Plastic Man
Here Comes Hawkeye/Listen to the Mockingbird
description: The debut of the series you've been demanding! Now you can read the solo adventures of Hawkeye every month and also catch up on the solo exploits of his Avenging buddies! First up: Hawkeye joins the circus, only to encounter a villain from his distant past! And what's Mockingbird doing while her hubby's at the circus? Why she's fighting the very same villain!

issue_title: The Sinking of Los Angeles/Token Sacrifice
description: A peaceful electronics exhibition takes a deadly turn when it becomes the scene of a no-holds-barred fight between Hawkeye and a group of terrorists! Also: Dr. Druid takes on an ancient evil - in the subway tunnels beneath Manhattan!

issue_title: The Menace of the Mind-Melder/A Farewell--With Arms
description: Hawkeye's sure got his hands full this time around! Not only does he have to cope with a foe who can take over the bodies of people around him, but he's also got to avoid being skewered by "The Claws of the Bobcat!" Also: Dionysus, the Greek god of good-timin' fun, is determined to kill himself! Only Hercules can stop Dionysus, but this time, Hercules discovers that the only way he can save his friend is by using his brain, not his brawn!

issue_title: When the Abomination Comes A'Calling/Love Stings
description: Hawkeye's bow and arrow may be a match for most run-of-the-mill weapons, but how will he fare against the living weapon known as the Abomination? Plus: As one of the Masters of Evil, the new Yellowjacket was a formidable threat to the Avengers. But now, their relationship takes on a whole new light as she tries to become a super-heroine!

There's a mad chase in store for Hawkeye when he takes on the high-speed menace called Bullet Biker! It's going to be tough for Hawkeye to beat Bullet Biker ... assuming he can even catch him! Also: Some alien filmmakers have come to town and Wonder Man is the start of their latest epic. The only problem is - they haven't bothered to tell him first! Can even Wonder Man stand up to the threat of the incredible giant mutant bunny?

issue_title: When the Widow Calls; Court Costs!
description: When the Black Widow finds herself about to be snuffed by A.I.M., it's Hawkeye to the rescue! Also: who's the strongest female in the Marvel Universe - Titania or the She-Hulk?

issue_title: The Awesome Attackoid!; Ronin on Empty
description: Hawkeye has been reunited with his old partner, the Black Widow. And it's a good thing--the avenging archer is going to need all the help he can get when he faces the hordes of A.I.M.! Also: The giant robot, Red Ronin, is out of control! And the only one who can halt its mad rampage is -- the winsome Wasp?!

issue_title: The Sinister Secret of SODAM; Seconds!
description: It's been a long time since Hawkeye and Black Widow fought as a team. But now, it looks like they may die together unless they can find a way to thwart the plans of A.I.M.! Plus: An old friend of Starfox's is in trouble, and to save her, he's got to visit a planet where everything's illegal--everything but commerce and violence, that is!

issue_title: Even An Octopus Needs Arms; Greed
description: Hawkeye has faced his share of powerful foes. But even with the Sandman at his side, how can the Avengers' ace archer overcome the deadly tentacles of Doctor Octopus? The Sub-Marine must face the most surprising foe of all! Who is it? Heck, if we told you, it wouldn't be a surprise!

issue_title: When You Wish Upon A Star; Will You, Won't You
description: The Texas Twister is back. He's possessed by a blood-mad demon! How can Hawkeye stop his tornado-powered rampage? Plus: The Vision must use logic to defeat a murderous madman. But the paradox is that to win, the Vision must use methods that defy logic!

issue_title: Desert Doom; The Vanities of Philip Whitehead
description: Plant Man's never met a plant he couldn't use to try and kill a super hero - as Hawkeye's about to find out! Being both a king and a super hero might strike you as being something great. But for Black Panther, the combination's about to prove to be a killer!

issue_title: The Way of the Arrow/Out of Control
description: There's a new villain in town and his name is Trickshot! What is the true story behind Hawkeye's origin? Plus: Captain Marvel confronts the South American dictator who was responsible for her powers ... and now wants them for his own!

issue_title: Veg Out; The Sun and Moon
description:
Hawkeye and Orb are being devoured by a carnivorous plant. They escape by Hawkeye shoving a flare arrow into the plant's throat. Orb tries to escape from Hawkeye only to be captured by Plant Man again. Hawkeye frees him and they both escape into the desert again. Plant Man escapes when his mini-ecosytem rockets away on boosters.

Cloud comes to visit Moondragon (now a young child) and Isaac. Demeityr and Pamela grow closer still, when Moondragon has a tantrum and attacks them. Pamela is able to partially defend herself with the limited psionic powers Moondragon helped her unlock. Heather teleports Pamela, Demeityr and Isaac into the void of space where they are rescued by the Dragon of the Sun.

Pamela is reborn as Sundragon and Gargoyle is given a new body which he can transform into human or gargoyle form. Moondragon apologizes for her childish behavior and leave for earth. Pamela, Isaac and Demeityr remain in space flying on the Dragon of the Sun.

issue_title: An American Archer in Paris/Tower of Shadows
description: When Trickshot lures Hawkeye to Paris, the Avengers' age archer finds himself facing Batroc the Leaper, Machete, and Zaran the Weapons Master, better known as Batroc's Brigade! Also: Moon Knight battles the ebon-cloaked Shroud! But which one is Marvel's true master of darkness?

Hawkeye's been arrested for murder! Can the Avengers' ace archer escape Silver Sable's castle to prove his innocence? Also: It began with Dr. Druid examining the Black Knight's mystic ebony blade. Then Dr. Druid was possessed by the spirit of the Black Knight's last descedant, who reveals the blade's bloody curse! Will the Black Knight obey his descendant and destroy the blade, and thus save future generations? The answer, the Black Knight discovers, is not as simple as it seems!

issue_title: When Arrows Fail/A Love That Never Dies
description: It's an archery duel to the death between Hawkeye and Trick Shot! Silver Sable's trying to save Hawkeye from the duel, because she knows that Trick Shot has made sure there's no way Hawkeye can win! Plus: Scarlet Witch must use all her skills of sorcery to save a woman who is not only haunted by her dead lover ... but who won't rest until he's taken her into the land of the dead!

Remember the Communist Red Skull of the 1950s? Well, neither did Hawkeye - at least, not until the ace archer found himself in Algeria, trying to stop this Red Skull from triggering a nuclear holocaust! Plus: The Falcon takes on Scatterbrain, the brand new super-villain who's driving Harlem wild!

It's danger in a crowded airport when Hawkeye, Silver Sable and the Sandman suddenly find themselves "Hijacked!" Plus: It's been a long time since the Black Widow defected from Russia. But with her old mentor gravely ill, the Widow has to break into the Russian Embassy to see her one last time!

You'd think Hawkeye would welcome a new costumed hero, wouldn't you? Well, not when the "hero" is a brutal vigilante! Plus: Dr. Pym may not be able to grow and shrink anymore, but his old enemy Dr. Nemesis still can! When Dr. Nemesis returns for revenge, how can the scientific adventurer survive?

The masked vigilante, Blind Justice has been tracking down criminals of all types - and sentencing them to death! Even with the aid of the ebon-cloaked Shroud, can Hawkeye stop Blind Justice before he kills again? Plus: Once they were man and wife. But when Hellcat takes on the murderously maniacal Mad Dog ... (dare we say it?) all Hell breaks loose!
